title: A Bird Lighter Than a Nickel Flies 500 Miles Across the Ocean

scenes.text: A bird lighter than a nickel flies across the ocean.
The ruby-throated hummingbird weighs about three grams.
Before migrating, it nearly doubles that weight by eating.
Then it crosses the Gulf of Mexico, over five hundred miles.
It flies about eighteen to twenty hours without stopping.
Its wings sweep about fifty times every second.
Lighter than a nickel, and over five hundred miles. Watch it again.

description:
A bird lighter than a nickel flies across the ocean.
The ruby-throated hummingbird crosses over 500 miles of the Gulf of Mexico in about 18 to 20 hours without stopping.
Would you cross an ocean with no rest?
first_comment: Bonus: it gains about half its body weight in fat before the trip. Could you do that?
